title: Input schema of the Twitch Streamer Engagement Stats

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Twitch channel pages to monitor (e.g., https://www.twitch.tv/<channel>).

samplingIntervalSeconds.title: Sampling interval (seconds)
samplingIntervalSeconds.description: Interval between samples used to compute chat message rate.

durationSeconds.title: Duration (seconds)
durationSeconds.description: How long to sample each channel in seconds. Set 0 for continuous until Actor stopped (use with caution).

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Requests per Crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of pages the crawler will open per run.

chatSelectors.title: Chat selectors (optional)
chatSelectors.description: CSS selectors to count chat messages. Leave empty to use built-in heuristics.

viewerSelectors.title: Viewer count selectors (optional)
viewerSelectors.description: CSS selectors to extract viewer count. Leave empty to use built-in heuristics.

useProxy.title: Use Apify proxy
useProxy.description: Enable Apify Proxy via Actor.createProxyConfiguration(). Recommended for scale.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate samples in KV
dedupe.description: If true, store summary keys in Key-Value store to avoid duplicate aggregated pushes.
